sentences.en: A significant quantity of mercury was found in the mackerel.
Foreign products arrived on the market in large quantities.
sentences.zh: 外国产品以大宗数量涌入市场。

sentences.en: These goods are greater in quantity than in quality.
sentences.zh: 这些商品的数量多于质量。

senses.zh: 量，数目；大量，大批；（尤指和质量相对的）数量；（语音）音量；值，参量；代表数量（或参量）的数（或符号）
